chunks: And in another report, he said:
There is no harm in a woman whose husband has passed away performing hajj while she is in her waiting period, and moving from one house to another.

key_terms.الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا: a woman whose husband has died
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Can a widow perform hajj and move houses during her 'iddah?
ai.summary: This report gives a legal ruling concerning a widow during her 'iddah. It states that there is no harm in her performing hajj during that period and in moving from one residence to another.
